newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber to install Stanford network.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber to install Stanford network.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Thursday it will invest more than $16 million in the building and operation of a new fiber optic network in the Stanford, Conn. area.

The network will operate under the name Brooks Fiber Communications of Connecticut Inc. The network will bring to 30 the number of U.S. metropolitan networks operating or under construction by Brooks.
Construction of the network will begin by year end, the company said, and is expected to be completed by the end of second quarter 1997.
